title: Onix Ram damage and damage-free recovery

verification.actor: One current WILD Onix (species 95) at map 33 tile (585,411), with the player at (585,407).
verification.trigger: Let Onix choose its normal Ram while the player stands still. Then move the hurt player to a safe tile and wait without input.
verification.observable: One Ram changes saved and live HP from 100 to 67 without battle and jumps the player from (585,407) to (585,404), with an elevated face height and a stationary movement command. At a safe tile, five stationary seconds do not heal; the next second heals 10 HP. Normal movement keeps the wait and healing rate.

setupMutations.change: Use checked teleport, native Wild Onix spawn four tiles from the player, and exact live identity bind. Keep Onix movement, Ram policy, damage, and player HP unmodified.
Use checked teleport to map 34 tile (550,381) only after the Ram receipt. This removes later Onix attacks from the rest measurement.

limits: Prepared Onix placement tests the real Ram collision and HP path, not natural population spawn selection.
The safe-tile teleport and two measured field-settle frames precede the 360 stationary game frames; the first HP read records any arrival rest credit.
A missing current Onix, incorrect HP/save value, missing or extra knockback, battle transition, player motion during rest, wrong frame count, or lost healing during movement fails.

events.value: Place and bind Onix four tiles from the player.
Observe a natural Ram contact and exact HP loss.
Move the injured player to the safe rest tile.
Observe 300 still frames, 60 healing frames, and 16 moving healing frames.

stop.condition: One checked Ram, two field-settle frames, rest threshold, 10 HP heal, and continued moving heal, or the first failed identity, clock, HP, or field observation.

invariants: Current WILD Onix owns the Ram window
HP and saved HP stay equal
Rest uses 360 exact still field frames
